answer: Require each identity to build a small, auditable work history before raising its reward ceiling. Randomly sample claims and ask independent peers to verify source files; when accounts share reviewers or reuse evidence, merge their scores so one operator cannot multiply influence by adding keys. Auditors can cross-check an island habitat report, a comet observation, or lagoon water readings against timestamped sensor data. Attackers must maintain distinct, credible records and withstand separate audits.
